   but is not a guarantee that an audit conducted in accordance with CSAs         計準則執行的審計在某一重大錯報存在時總

   can arise from fraud or error and are considered material if, individually     果合理預期錯報單獨或匯總起來可能影響財

      Basis of book-keeping and principle of measurement                               記帳基礎和計價原則
      The Group adopts the accrual basis as the basis of book-keeping in               本集團會計核算以權責發生制為記帳基礎。
      accounting. Other than certain financial instruments, these financial            除某些金融工具外，本財務報表以歷史成本
      statements have been prepared at historical costs. Disposal group held-          作為計量基礎。持有待售的處置組，按照賬
      for-sale is carried at the lower of carrying amount or the net value of          面價值與公允價值減去出售費用後的淨額孰
      fair value less selling expenses. If the assets are impaired, corresponding      低列報。資產如果發生減值，則按照相關規
      provisions for impairment shall be made according to relevant provisions.        定計提相應的減值準備。


      Under historical cost method, the amount of assets was measured at the           在歷史成本計量下，資產按照購置時支付的
      fair value of cash or cash equivalents or consideration paid at the time         現金或者現金等價物的金額或者所付出的對
      of purchase. Liabilities were measured at the amount of money or assets          價的公允價值計量。負債按照因承擔現時義
      due to the current obligations actually received, or a present obligation        務而實際收到的款項或者資產的金額，或者
      of the contract amount, or the measurement of cash or cash equivalents           承擔現時義務的合同金額，或者按照日常活

     The fair value refers to the amount, at which both willing parties                    公允價值是市場參與者在計量日發生的有序
     engaged to an orderly transaction who are familiar with the condition sell            交易中，出售一項資產所能收到或者轉移一
     their assets or transfer their liabilities. Whether the fair value is observable      項負債所需支付的價格。無論公允價值是可
     or measured by valuation techniques, the measurement and disclosure of                觀察到的還是採用估值技術估計的，在本財
     the fair value in these financial statements were all based on it.                    務報表中計量和披露的公允價值均在此基礎
                                                                                           上予以確定。


     For financial assets with transaction prices as the fair value upon initial           對於以交易價格作為初始確認時的公允價
     recognition and a valuation technique that unobservable inputs are to be              值，且在公允價值後續計量中使用了涉及不
     used to measure fair value in subsequent periods, the valuation technique             可觀察輸入值的估值技術的金融資產，在估
     is calibrated so that the results of the valuation technique equals to the            值過程中校正該估值技術，以使估值技術確
     transaction price.                                                                    定的初始確認結果與交易價格相等。


     Fair value measurements are categorized into three levels based on the                公允價值計量基於公允價值的輸入值的可觀
     degree to which the inputs of the fair value measurements are observable              察程度以及該等輸入值對公允價值計量整體
     and the significance of the inputs to the fair value measurement in its               的重要性，被劃分為三個層次：
     entirety, which are described as follows:


     •     Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets                 •   第一層次輸入值是在計量日能夠取得
           for identical assets or liabilities that the entity can access at the               的相同資產或負債在活躍市場上未經
           measurement date.                                                                   調整的報價。


     •     Level 2 inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices included within             •   第二層次輸入值是除第一層次輸入值
           Level 1, that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly            外相關資產或負債直接或間接可觀察
           or indirectly.                                                                      的輸入值。


     •     Level 3 inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or liability.              •   第三層次輸入值是相關資產或負債的
                                                                                               不可觀察輸入值。

     7.   Classification of joint arrangements and accounting                            7.   合營安排分類及共同經營會計處
          treatments for joint operations                                                     理方法
          Joint arrangements include joint operations and joint ventures. The                 合營安排分為共同經營和合營企業，
          classification is determined by considering the structure, legal form               該分類通過考慮該安排的結構、法律

     24. Accruals and provisions                                                      24. 預計負債
          Except for contingent consideration transferred and contingent                 除了非同一控制下企業合併中的或有
          liability assumed in business combinations involving entities not              對價及承擔的或有負債之外，當與或
          under common control, the Group recognizes an obligation related               有事項相關的義務同時符合以下條
          to a contingency as a provision when all of the following conditions           件，本集團將其確認為預計負債：
          are satisfied:


          (1)    the obligation is a present obligation of the Group;                    (1)   該義務是本集團承擔的現時義
                                                                                               務；


          (2)    it is probable that an outflow of economic benefits from the            (2)   該義務的履行很可能導致經濟利
                 Group will be required to settle the obligation;                              益流出本集團；


          (3)    the amount of the obligation can be measured reliably.                  (3)   該義務的金額能夠可靠地計量。


          A provision is initially measured at the best estimate of the                  預計負債按照履行相關現時義務所需
          expenditure required to settle the related present obligation,                 支出的最佳估計數進行初始計量，並
          with comprehensive consideration of factors such as the risks,                 綜合考慮與或有事項有關的風險、不
          uncertainty and time value of money relating to a contingency. The             確定性和貨幣時間價值等因素。每個
          carrying amount of a provision is reviewed at the balance sheet                資產負債表日對預計負債的賬面價值

          Interpretation No. 14 of Accounting Standards for                                企業會計準則解釋第14號
          Business Enterprises
          On 2 February 2021, the MOF has issued and implemented the                      財政部於2021年2月2日發佈實施《企
          “Interpretation No. 14 of Accounting Standards for Business                     業會計準則解釋第14號》
                                                                                                     （以下簡稱「解
          Enterprises” (the “Interpretation No. 14”), stipulating the                     釋14號」），規範了基準利率改革導致
          accounting treatment for changes to the basis for determining the               相關合同現金流量的確定基礎發生變
          contractual cash flows resulting from the reform of benchmark                   更的會計處理。
          rate.


          In case of any changes to the basis for determining the contractual             對於基準利率改革導致相關合同現金
          cash flows resulting from the reform of benchmark rate, when the                流量的確定基礎發生變更的情形，當
          basis for determining the contractual cash flow of financial assets             僅因基準利率改革直接導致採用實際
          or financial liabilities for which the interest income or expense is            利率法確定利息收入或費用的金融資
          determined using the effective interest rate method is changed                  產或金融負債合同現金流量的確定基
          solely due to the reform of the benchmark interest rate and the                 礎發生變更，且變更前後的確定基礎

             credit risk. Therefore, no provision for losses was made.                                 的信用風險，因此未計提損失準備。
